reason: B offers the more physically credible core mechanism: a refined, twin-rich subsurface can impede slip and limit high-temperature plastic wear, whereas A’s claim that thermally activated dislocation climb nucleates twins in the HEA is poorly supported and extrapolates a 300 K result concerning twins in the nickel substrate. B is still weakened by an underspecified treatment that may coarsen rather than refine grains, but its paired wear/microstructure experiment is capable of testing the proposed mediator.
